content: सामुद्रिक {%a.%} (-की|{%f.%}) [समुद्रेण प्रोक्तं वेत्त्यधीते वा ठञ्] .²1 Sea-born, oceanic. .²2 Sea-faring; सामुद्रिकान् सवणिजस्ततोऽपश्यत् स्थितान् पथि <ls>Mb. 12. 169. 2</ls>. .²2 Relating to marks on the body (which are supposed to indicate good or bad fortune). .{@-कः@} .²1 One who is acquainted with palmistry, who knows how to interpret the various marks on the body. .²2 A fortune-teller. .{@-कम्@} The science of palmistry.
